records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.unlock_method: Own Future Saga Chapter 4 and complete the Chapter 4 story through Quest 31, Ultimate All-Out Showdown.
records.source_quest_or_shop: Future Saga Chapter 4 — Quest 31, Ultimate All-Out Showdown
records.skill_description: Universal CaC Awoken Skill with an initial state and a stronger unleashed second stage.
records.mechanics_notes: Two-stage Awoken. Stage 1 has a documented +20% all-damage defense effect and +5% movement speed in current community testing, plus automatic HP recovery while below 50% HP and an unblockable sword-strike replacement for grabs. Re-inputting the Awoken command activates Unleashed Stage 2: approximately 12 seconds of effectively/infinite Ki regeneration, +15% basic attack damage, +30% Strike/Ki Super damage, and increased movement speed; HP drains during Stage 2 and a cooldown follows before reactivation. Sources disagree on some exact Stage 2 speed/cooldown values (reports include +10% vs +15% speed and ~24 vs ~30 sec cooldown), so those fields remain unresolved.
records.notes: Core identity, universal CaC availability, DLC requirement, and unlock route are verified. Current testing supports Stage 1 +20% defense/+5% speed and Stage 2 +30% Strike/Ki Super/+15% basic attack, but conflicting reports on Stage 2 speed/cooldown and exact HP regeneration rate remain intentionally unresolved.
